description: How many apps compete on each keyword in one storefront, returned for terms seen on two or more apps. Defaults to the app's tracked keywords; pass `terms` to count candidates before you track them. `corpus` is the size of the set behind the count.

country.description: country code, e.g. tr, us (defaults to the app's first country)

terms.description: up to 100 terms, comma separated (defaults to the tracked keywords)

name: get_keyword_competition
